newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Yilmaz says no more Ciller talks.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Yilmaz says no more Ciller talks.

text.p: Turkish conservative Mesut Yilmaz said on Wednesday he would not meet rival Tansu Ciller again in the search for an anti-Islamist coalition unless his opponent recognised him as prime minister-designate.
"It is impossible for me to meet Mrs Ciller if she does not change her attitude," Yilmaz told a news conference.
True Path Party leader Ciller, allied with the Islamists of caretaker Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan, on Tuesday rejected an offer from Yilmaz to join a coalition led by him.
President Suleyman Demirel last week appointed Yilmaz to form a government to replace the administration of Erbakan, who resigned under army pressure.
Yilmaz has given himself until early next week to present Demirel with a cabinet list.
He has won the backing of secularist MPs from most opposition parties but needs the support of around a dozen True Path deputies to win a vote of confidence in the 550-member parliament.
